purpose: Illustrative manuscript previews; not exact quantitative plots
style: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a polished scientific journal figure, landscape 3:2, high resolution. White background, clean flat vector-like raster artwork, navy typography, teal #158F92 and blue #4478B8, orange #DD8642 for alternative or unsupported extension, restrained lavender. Large readable English sans-serif labels, bold lowercase panel letters, fine axes, ample whitespace, no gradients, no decorative robot/cartoon scientists, no journal logos. Consistent coherent design for a paper titled How autonomous research shapes scientific understanding. This is an explicitly labeled ImageGen manuscript PREVIEW. Charts are illustrative geometry, never claim synthetic points are exact observations. Render exact numeric callouts when provided. Put small legible footer: 'IMAGEGEN PREVIEW | Illustrative geometry'.

figures.title: Research and understanding shape one another
figures.prompt: Main Figure 1. Redesign a sophisticated four-panel conceptual overview. a (upper left): 'Autonomous inquiry' persistent chemical world, three elegantly simplified vessels with reaction, equilibrium, crystallization; agent's choices labeled 'Materials', 'Conditions', 'Measurements'; connect persistent sample history to observations. b (upper right): 'Controlled scientific worlds' two separate lanes: agent sees public information + observations; evaluator controls hidden laws + information conditions and independently checks withheld reference outcomes. NO arrow carrying hidden truth into agent knowledge. c (wide lower center): 'Understanding organizes further inquiry' a continuous loop: 'Observations' -> 'Candidate explanations' [Abduction] -> 'Testable expectations' [Deduction] -> 'Chosen experiments' -> 'New evidence' -> 'Retain, revise or withdraw' -> back to questions; two elegant central arcs labeled 'Research behavior' and 'Scientific understanding' visibly mutually shaping. Include a small fork from revised explanation to a new experiment. d thin bottom strip three aligned dimensions: 'Evidence acquired', 'Relationships supported', 'Later use and transfer'. Make framework visually substantive not a slide full of rounded cards. No invented metrics, no triumphalist ladder. Caption-like label 'Observable judgments, not a direct readout of internal cognition'.
